issues: Structure: The feature has no index.ts entry point. The spec requires exactly one entry point, index.ts, which re-exports the feature's entire public API, and nothing outside the feature imports any other file in it. The loyalty directory contains only punch-card.ts and summer-promo.ts with no index.ts, so the entire rule about re-exporting the public API is unmet and both files are unreachable through the mandated entry point.

Cohesion — one capability per feature: punch-card.ts (loyalty punches / free-scoop logic) and summer-promo.ts (seasonal banner text and flavor list) serve two unrelated purposes. The spec requires that if files serve two unrelated purposes they are two features; this directory mixes them into one unit.

Cohesion — no orphaned files: every file must be reachable from index.ts through its import graph. With no index.ts and no cross-imports, summer-promo.ts (and its SUMMER_FLAVORS/banner-text code) is orphaned: nothing imports it, so it is not part of any reachable import graph. Punch-card.ts is likewise not reachable via an entry point.

Style/naming: logic files must be verb-first kebab-case (e.g., build-menu.ts, pick-winners.ts). punch-card.ts is noun-first, violating the verb-first naming convention required by the service conventions referenced in the spec.
result.reason: The loyalty cohort fails the feature-module specification on multiple required criteria: there is no index.ts entry point that re-exports the feature's public API, the directory mixes two unrelated capabilities in one feature, and files are orphaned/unreachable because nothing imports them and no index.ts exists. It cannot be evaluated as a valid feature module under the spec.

issues: Missing required entry point: The specification requires 'Exactly one entry point, index.ts, which re-exports the feature's entire public API.' The loyalty directory has no index.ts file.

Orphaned files: The specification requires 'No orphaned files: every file in the directory is reachable from index.ts through its import graph.' Without an index.ts, both punch-card.ts and summer-promo.ts are orphaned.

Multiple capabilities in one feature: The specification requires 'One capability per feature: if the files serve two unrelated purposes, they are two features.' punch-card.ts handles loyalty punch card logic while summer-promo.ts handles summer promotion marketing - these are unrelated capabilities.
Missing types file: The specification requires 'Types live in a dedicated <feature>-types.ts file.' There is no loyalty-types.ts file.
No public API re-export: Without index.ts, there is no way for external consumers to import the feature's public API as required by the specification.
result.reason: The loyalty feature directory violates multiple required criteria from the specification, with the most critical being the absence of an index.ts entry point.
